scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build -w @blexo/api
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && npm run deploy -w @blexo/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @blexo/api" "npm run dev -w @blexo/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:migrations
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
